source_campaign: Funnel clone BG-TUR -> RO-TUR (roturkish.zlatenkluch.eu), RO cover

extra_rules: Romanian with correct diacritics (ă â î ș ț) rendered exactly; no Bulgarian/Cyrillic letters may remain anywhere in the image.
This is a 3D book mockup. Keep the book shape, angle, lighting, Turkish flag, Istanbul mosque photo, tea glass, baklava, seagull, icons and all colours identical; change only the text.
Front cover title in two lines in the same bold style and colours: 'LIMBA TURCĂ' (dark navy) and 'PENTRU ÎNCEPĂTORI' (red).
Spine text in the same style: 'LIMBA TURCĂ PENTRU ÎNCEPĂTORI' and the small subtitle lines translated the same way as on the front.
Do not add any new text, names or logos. Use a short hyphen, never a long dash.
